rootCauseOf9Drops: Injected Controls (3 drops): Microservices, Kubernetes, and AWS Lambda negative controls deliberately injected into deck bullets.

Rigid 10-cue chunk boundary slicing (6 drops): True facts from video (galactic center, every year, thousands of years, solar, visible, 2012) placed into Chunk 1 while slide cited Chunk 2 (or vice versa), failing single-chunk exact substring match.

changesThatMovedDropsFrom9of12To1of33: Removed all injected negative controls from model-output counts per strict evidence rules.
Contiguous transcript chunking: Slide planner aligns slides to actual contiguous caption chunks rather than artificial 10-cue slices.
Neighbour context window: Bullet verification checks cited chunk plus adjacent neighbour, preventing false chunk-boundary edge rejections on true facts.
Single regeneration on NO SUPPORT: Unsupported bullets are regenerated once against cited source excerpt before dropping, recovering valid phrasing.
